responsibility: This header declares the backend entry points implemented by the BPF target for use from generated machine-description code and target glue. It exposes prologue/epilogue expansion, conditional-branch expansion, call output, operand/address printing, frame-elimination offset calculation, target preprocessor macro emission, and construction of the BPF CO-RE attribute pass, serving as the interface between bpf.cc, bpf.md, and generic GCC target infrastructure.
